title: Selective Execution with an if Statement
description: Use an if statement with the comparison age >= 35 to print a message only when the condition evaluates to true.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Declare and initialize int age = 38 inside main.
Check the condition if(age >= 35) on line 5 and execute line 6 inside the braces when that condition is true.

steps.question: What happens when age is 38, and what would happen if age were changed to below the threshold?
steps.answer: When age is 38, 38 >= 35 is true, so line 6 prints the message. If age were below the threshold, the condition would be false, so the if body would be skipped and nothing would print.

steps.description: See age >= 35 evaluate to true for age = 38 and step into the if block on line 6.
